messages:
deploy-bot: starting partial rollout for /v2 on api-gateway
- mode: conservative canary
- initial traffic: 4% global, 0% APAC (manual gating)
- window: 2026-03-22 03:15-05:15 UTC
- auto-rollback: 5xx > 0.3% over 4m OR client-4xx spike > 1%
- operator contact: @ops-rita

priya: release notes updated with migration snippet & header-case FAQ: https://redwood.infer/releases/v2-compat-20260322

emily: heads-up: mobile SDKs older than 1.3 send X-Client-ID in mixed case; we added a case-insensitive parser but fallback may return 422. Recommend tenant pins for: edu-portal, acme-corp, legacy-pay.

kai: agree pin list. Also propose edge throttle for EU region for first hour (rate limit to 10rps/tenant) to limit blast radius.

ops-rita: applying tenant pins now:
`/deploy pin api-v2 tenant=edu-portal until=2026-03-22T14:00Z`
`/deploy pin api-v2 tenant=acme-corp until=2026-03-22T14:00Z`
`/deploy pin api-v2 tenant=legacy-pay until=2026-03-22T14:00Z`
Pins applied.

deploy-bot: edge throttle rule created for EU: tenant-rate-limit=10rps for first 60m. Rule id: throttle-556789

dev-lee: QA ran smoke on canary (non-pinned tenants). Two minor JSON schema diffs in reranker endpoints; filed bug #4701. No client-impacting 5xx.

support-ana: support ready; prepared canned reply for affected customers. Will coordinate with TAMs for pinned tenants.

deploy-bot: canary telemetry snapshot: p95=122ms, 5xx=0.02%, 4xx delta=0.3% vs baseline. Telemetry: https://telemetry.redwood/streams/v2-partial-4pct

emily: mobile sim showed 422 for legacy-pay sample. Since legacy-pay pinned, they will stay on v1. For non-pinned tenants, fallback works with our normalization lib.

kai: proceeding cautiously: hold auto-progress. Manual approval required to go to 10%. ops-rita please monitor APAC readiness before unpinning APAC traffic.

ops-rita: APAC region kept at 0% until 04:00 UTC for manual smoke there. Monitoring dashboards and synthetic checks.

priya: note in release notes about SDK quick-fix: client-side header normalize snippet and version bump to 1.3.1. Link in notes.

support-ana: drafted customer comms for acme-corp/TAM; will not send until we know final progress.

dev-lee: adding runbook entry: if 4xx spike observed from a tenant, first action: reduce that tenant traffic to 0% (pin) and escalate to ops. Full rollback only if 5xx threshold hit across canary.

ops-rita: acknowledged. Prepared rollback command: `/deploy rollback api-v2 --immediate` pinned to runbook.

priya: summary: pins applied for edu-portal/acme-corp/legacy-pay, EU throttle in place, APAC held at 0%, QA found non-critical diffs, manual approval to proceed to 10% pending APAC smoke at 04:00 UTC. I'll close after either manual advance or rollback.

deploy-bot: archived thread (deploy id: deploy-5567890123).
